findings.description: The regex check was changed from `match()` to `fullmatch()`, which the commit title (accept empty message) does not mention. Patterns now have to match the whole exception string, not just its start.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `retry_if_exception_message(match="timeout")` raising `Exception("timeout after 5s")`. `match()` used to return a match, but `fullmatch()` does not, so the retry silently stops happening. Existing users who relied on prefix matching see changed retry behavior, and it also affects `retry_if_not_exception_message`, which uses the same check.
